lessons.title: Menene Shirye-shirye (Programming)?
lessons.content:
Programming (shirye-shirye) shine aikin rubuta umarni (code) da ke gaya wa kwamfuta abin da za ta yi, mataki-mataki. Kwamfuta ba ta da hankalin kanta - tana bin dai-dai abin da aka rubuta mata, don haka mai shirye-shirye (programmer) yana bukatar tunani a fili kuma cikin tsari.

Akwai yaruka (languages) da yawa da ake amfani da su wajen shirye-shirye - kamar Python, JavaScript, da Java - kowanne yana da nasa dokoki (syntax), amma dukkansu suna raba manyan ka'idoji iri ɗaya kamar masu canji, sharadi, da madaukai.

quiz.question: Menene Programming?
options: Rubuta umarni da ke gaya wa kwamfuta abin da za ta yi
quiz.explanation: Programming shine rubuta code domin gaya wa kwamfuta abin da za ta aikata.

quiz.question: Shin kwamfuta tana da hankalin kanta wajen fahimtar umarni?
options: A'a, tana bin dai-dai abin da aka rubuta mata
E, tana da hankali kamar mutum
quiz.explanation: Kwamfuta tana bin umarnin da aka bata dai-dai, ba tare da hankalinta ba.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na yaren shirye-shirye?
quiz.explanation: Python yare ne sananne na shirye-shirye da ake amfani da shi don ayyuka daban-daban.

quiz.question: Me ke hade dukkan yarukan shirye-shirye?
options: Manyan ka'idoji kamar masu canji, sharadi, da madaukai
Babu wani abin da ke hade su
Su duka iri ɗaya ne gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Ko da yake syntax ya bambanta, manyan ka'idoji na programming iri ɗaya ne a mafi yawan yaruka.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar tunani a fili wajen shirye-shirye?
options: Domin kwamfuta tana bin umarni dai-dai kamar yadda aka rubuta
quiz.explanation: Rashin tsari a tunani na iya kawo kuskure a code domin kwamfuta ba za ta iya fahimtar niyya ba.

lessons.title: Masu Canji da Nau'ukan Bayanai
lessons.summary: Yadda ake ajiye bayanai a cikin code
lessons.content:
Variable (mai canji) wani wuri ne a cikin memory na kwamfuta wanda ake bashi suna domin ajiye wani bayani, kamar suna, lamba, ko gaskiya/karya. Misali, za a iya rubuta 'age = 25' domin ajiye lambar 25 a wani wuri mai suna 'age'.

Akwai nau'ukan bayanai (data types) daban-daban: Integer (lambobi cikakku kamar 25), String (rubutu kamar "Sannu"), Boolean (gaskiya ko karya - true/false), da Float (lambobi masu tsit kamar 3.14). Sanin wanne nau'i ake amfani da shi yana taimaka wa kwamfuta sarrafa bayanan daidai.

quiz.question: Menene Variable?
options: Wuri a memory da ake bashi suna domin ajiye bayani
quiz.explanation: Variable yana ajiye bayani a memory tare da suna da za a iya amfani da shi.

quiz.question: Wanne nau'in bayani ne 'Sannu' (rubutu)?
quiz.explanation: String shine nau'in bayani da ke wakiltar rubutu.

quiz.question: Wanne nau'in bayani ne 'true' ko 'false'?
quiz.explanation: Boolean yana wakiltar gaskiya (true) ko karya (false) kawai.

quiz.question: Wanne nau'in bayani ne lamba 25?
quiz.explanation: Integer shine nau'in bayani na lambobi cikakku ba tare da tsit ba.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar sanin nau'ukan bayanai daban-daban?
options: Domin kwamfuta ta sarrafa bayanan daidai
quiz.explanation: Kowane nau'in bayani ana sarrafa shi daban, don haka sanin bambanci yana da muhimmanci.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake ajiye bayanai a cikin code

lessons.title: Sharadi (Conditionals) - If/Else
lessons.content:
Conditionals (sharadi) suna bawa code damar yanke shawara bisa wani hali - misali, 'idan (if) shekarunka sun kai 18, to za ka iya jefa kuri'a; in ba haka ba (else), ba za ka iya ba'. A code, ana rubuta wannan a matsayin 'if age >= 18: ... else: ...'.

Wadannan sharuɗɗa suna sa code ta zama mai amfani sosai domin za ta iya bada amsa daban-daban bisa yanayi daban-daban, maimakon ta yi abu ɗaya kacal koyaushe ba tare da la'akari da halin da ake ciki ba.

quiz.question: Menene aikin 'if' a code?
options: Yana bawa code damar yanke shawara bisa wani hali
quiz.explanation: If yana bincika hali sannan ya aiwatar da wani sashi na code bisa sakamakon.

quiz.question: Menene 'else' ke yi a code?
options: Yana aiwatar da wani sashi idan sharadin 'if' bai cika ba
quiz.explanation: Else yana bada madadin abin da za a yi idan sharadin farko bai cika ba.

quiz.question: A misalin shekaru 18, wanne sharadi ne za a iya amfani da shi?
quiz.explanation: if age >= 18 yana bincika ko shekaru sun kai 18 ko sama.

quiz.question: Me yasa conditionals ke da amfani a programming?
options: Suna bada damar code ya bada amsa daban-daban bisa yanayi
Suna sa code ya yi abu ɗaya kacal koyaushe
quiz.explanation: Ba tare da conditionals ba, code ba zai iya daidaita bisa yanayi daban-daban ba.

quiz.question: Wanne kalma ne ake amfani da ita don bincika hali a mafi yawan yaruka?
quiz.explanation: 'if' ita ce kalmar da aka fi amfani da ita don bincika sharadi a programming.

lessons.title: Madaukai (Loops)
lessons.summary: Yadda ake maimaita aiki a code
lessons.content:
Loop (madauki) yana bada damar code ya maimaita wani aiki sau da yawa ba tare da rubuta shi sau da yawa da hannu ba. Misali, idan kana son buga lambobi daga 1 zuwa 100, za ka iya amfani da loop maimakon rubuta layuka 100 daban-daban.

Akwai nau'i biyu na gama-gari: 'for loop' (wanda ke gudana wani adadin sau da aka sani tun farko) da 'while loop' (wanda ke ci gaba da gudana matukar wani sharadi yana gaskiya). Loops suna ɗaya daga cikin kayan aikin da suka fi muhimmanci a programming domin suna rage maimaita rubutun code.

quiz.question: Menene Loop?
options: Wani abu da ke maimaita aiki sau da yawa
quiz.explanation: Loop yana maimaita wani aiki sau da yawa ba tare da rubuta shi kowace lokaci ba.

quiz.question: Menene 'for loop'?
options: Loop wanda ke gudana wani adadin sau da aka sani tun farko
Loop wanda ba ya kare koyaushe
quiz.explanation: For loop yana da tabbatacce adadin sau da zai gudana.

quiz.question: Menene 'while loop'?
options: Loop wanda ke ci gaba matukar wani sharadi yana gaskiya
Loop wanda ke gudana sau ɗaya kadai
quiz.explanation: While loop yana ci gaba da gudana har sai sharadin ya zama karya.

quiz.question: Wanne aiki loop zai iya sauƙaƙa?
quiz.explanation: Loop yana sauƙaƙa maimaita aiki mai yawa kamar buga lambobi da yawa.

quiz.question: Me yasa loops ke da muhimmanci a programming?
options: Suna kara rikitar da code ba dalili
quiz.explanation: Loops suna bada damar rubuta karamin code wanda zai iya yin aiki mai yawa.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake maimaita aiki a code

lessons.title: Ayyuka (Functions)
lessons.summary: Yadda ake tsara code zuwa sassa masu sake amfani
lessons.content:
Function (aiki) wani tsari ne na code da aka bashi suna, wanda za a iya amfani dashi sau da yawa a wurare daban-daban na babban code din, maimakon sake rubuta shi kowane lokaci. Misali, za a iya kirkirar function mai suna 'addNumbers' wanda ke karban lambobi biyu ya mayar da jimlarsu.

Functions suna sa code ya zama mai tsari, sauki wajen karantawa, kuma sauki wajen gyarawa - idan wani kuskure ya faru a wani aiki, za ka iya gyara shi a wuri ɗaya kacal (a cikin function din) maimakon a duk wurin da aka rubuta wannan code.

quiz.question: Menene Function?
options: Tsarin code da aka bashi suna wanda za a sake amfani dashi
quiz.explanation: Function yana bada damar sake amfani da wani code sau da yawa.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce Functions ke bayarwa?
options: Suna sa code ya zama mai tsari, sauki wajen karantawa da gyarawa
quiz.explanation: Functions suna inganta tsari da sauki na code.

quiz.question: Idan kuskure ya faru a wani aiki da function ke yi, ina za a gyara shi?
options: A wuri ɗaya kacal, a cikin function din
A duk wurin da aka rubuta wannan code
Ba za a iya gyara ba
quiz.explanation: Domin function tana da wuri ɗaya, gyara can yana warware matsalar a ko'ina ake amfani da ita.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na abin da function zata iya yi?
options: Karban lambobi biyu ta mayar da jimlarsu
quiz.explanation: addNumbers misali ne mai sauki na function da ke aiwatar da wani aiki na musamman.

quiz.question: Me ya sa aka bawa function suna?
options: Domin a iya kiran ta daga ko'ina a cikin code
quiz.explanation: Suna yana bada damar kiran function din daga wurare daban-daban a code din.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake tsara code zuwa sassa masu sake amfani

lessons.title: Zaben Yaren Shirye-shirye na Farko
lessons.summary: Wanne yare ya fi dacewa a matsayin farko
lessons.content:
Ga masu farawa, Python ana ba da shawarar sosai domin syntax dinsa mai sauki ne kuma kusa da yaren Turanci na yau da kullum. Python ana amfani da shi wajen ayyuka daban-daban: nazarin bayanai, AI, da gina shafukan yanar gizo.

JavaScript kuma zabi ne mai kyau musamman idan kana son gina shafukan yanar gizo, domin shine kadai yare da ke aiki kai tsaye a browser. Babu 'daidai' yare guda ɗaya - zaɓi ya kamata ya dogara ne akan abin da kake son ginawa a nan gaba, amma Python ta fi sauki don koyon manyan ka'idojin programming da farko.

quiz.question: Wanne yare ne ake ba da shawarar sosai ga masu farawa?
quiz.explanation: Python yana da syntax mai sauki, don haka ya dace da masu farawa.

quiz.question: Me yasa Python ke da sauki ga masu farawa?
options: Domin syntax dinsa yana kusa da yaren Turanci na yau da kullum
Domin ba shi da wani amfani
quiz.explanation: Syntax mai sauki yana taimaka wa masu farawa fahimtar ka'idojin programming da sauri.

quiz.question: Wanne yare ne kadai ke aiki kai tsaye a browser?
quiz.explanation: JavaScript shine yaren da browsers ke iya gudanar dashi kai tsaye ba tare da wani kayan aiki na musamman ba.

quiz.question: A wanne fanni ake amfani da Python?
options: Nazarin bayanai, AI, da gina shafukan yanar gizo
quiz.explanation: Python yare ne mai amfani sosai wajen fannoni daban-daban.

quiz.question: Shin akwai yare 'daidai' guda ɗaya wanda kowa ya kamata ya koya?
options: A'a, zabi ya dogara ne akan abin da kake son ginawa
E, Python ne kadai daidai koyaushe
quiz.explanation: Zaben yare ya dogara ne da bukatar aikin da ake son yi a nan gaba.

diagram.caption: Wanne yare ya fi dacewa a matsayin farko

lessons.title: Tsarin Bayanai (Arrays/Lists)
lessons.summary: Yadda ake ajiye tarin bayanai a code
lessons.content:
Array (ko List a wasu yaruka) tsari ne na ajiye tarin bayanai da yawa a wuri guda, kamar jerin sunayen dalibai ko lambobin sakamako. Kowane abu a cikin array yana da 'index' (matsayi) na musamman, wanda yawanci yana farawa daga 0, ba 1 ba.

Misali, idan kana da array na sunaye ['Amina', 'Bello', 'Aisha'], 'Amina' tana da index 0, 'Bello' index 1, kuma 'Aisha' index 2. Wannan tsari yana bada damar sarrafa bayanai da yawa cikin sauki, misali ta hanyar amfani da loop domin duba kowane suna a jerin.

quiz.question: Menene Array/List?
options: Tsari na ajiye tarin bayanai a wuri guda
quiz.explanation: Array/List yana ajiye bayanai da yawa a tsari ɗaya.

quiz.question: Menene 'index' a array?
quiz.explanation: Index yana nuna matsayin kowane abu a cikin array din.

quiz.question: A yawancin yaruka, wanne lamba ake farawa da ita wajen index?
quiz.explanation: Yawancin yaruka na programming suna farawa da index 0, ba 1 ba.

quiz.question: A misalin ['Amina', 'Bello', 'Aisha'], wace index ce 'Bello' take da ita?
quiz.explanation: Bello yana matsayi na biyu, wanda index dinsa shine 1 (domin farawa daga 0).

quiz.question: Ta yaya loop ke amfani da array?
options: Domin duba kowane abu a cikin array ɗaya bayan ɗaya
Domin share array din gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Loop yana bada damar zagayawa cikin dukkan abubuwan da ke cikin array cikin sauki.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake ajiye tarin bayanai a code

lessons.title: Object-Oriented Programming
lessons.summary: Tsara code bisa abubuwa da kaddarorinsu
lessons.content:
Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) wata dabara ce ta tsara code inda ake wakiltar abubuwa na ainihin duniya (kamar mota, mutum, ko asusun banki) a matsayin 'objects' masu kaddarori (properties) da ayyuka (methods) nasu. Misali, wani 'Car' object zai iya samun kaddarorin 'color' da 'speed', da ayyukan 'accelerate()' ko 'brake()'.

Tsarin da ake amfani da shi wajen bayyana wadannan objects ana kiransa 'class' - kamar tsari (template) ne, kuma object shine ainihin abin da aka gina bisa wannan tsari. OOP yana taimaka wa manyan ayyukan software su zama masu tsari da sauki wajen fadadawa.

quiz.question: Menene Object-Oriented Programming?
options: Dabarar tsara code inda ake wakiltar abubuwa a matsayin objects
quiz.explanation: OOP yana wakiltar abubuwan duniya a matsayin objects masu kaddarori da ayyuka.

quiz.question: Menene 'class' a OOP?
options: Tsari (template) da ake amfani da shi wajen bayyana objects
quiz.explanation: Class shine tsarin da ake gina objects a kai.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na 'property' na Car object?
quiz.explanation: Color kaddara ce (property), yayin da accelerate() da brake() ayyuka ne (methods).

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na 'method' na Car object?
quiz.explanation: accelerate() aiki ne (method) da Car object zai iya yi.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce OOP ke bayarwa ga manyan ayyukan software?
options: Sauki wajen fadadawa da tsari mai kyau
quiz.explanation: OOP yana taimaka wa manyan ayyuka su zama masu tsari da sauki wajen kulawa.

diagram.caption: Tsara code bisa abubuwa da kaddarorinsu

lessons.title: Git da Version Control
lessons.summary: Yadda ake bin diddigin canje-canje a code
lessons.content:
Git kayan aiki ne na 'version control' wanda ke bin diddigin kowane canji da aka yi wa code na wani aiki, ta yadda za a iya komawa zuwa wani tsohon sigar idan wani sabon canji ya haifar da matsala. Wannan yana da matukar muhimmanci musamman lokacin da injiniyoyi da yawa ke aiki akan aiki ɗaya tare.

GitHub kuma dandali ne na intanet wanda ke amfani da Git domin bada damar injiniyoyi su adana kuma su raba code dinsu tare da wasu. Kowane canji da injiniya ya yi ana kiransa 'commit', kuma ana iya duba tarihin dukkan wadannan canje-canje a kowane lokaci.

quiz.question: Menene Git?
options: Kayan aiki na version control da ke bin diddigin canje-canje a code
quiz.explanation: Git yana bin diddigin tarihin canje-canjen da aka yi wa code.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar version control?
options: Domin za a iya komawa zuwa tsohon sigar idan wani sabon canji ya haifar da matsala
quiz.explanation: Version control yana bada damar dawowa idan sabon canji ya kawo matsala.

quiz.question: Menene GitHub?
options: Dandali na intanet da ke amfani da Git domin adanawa da raba code
quiz.explanation: GitHub yana bada dandali don adana da raba code ta amfani da Git.

quiz.question: Menene 'commit' a Git?
options: Kowane canji da injiniya ya yi wa code
quiz.explanation: Commit yana wakiltar wani canji da aka yi kuma aka adana a tarihin Git.

quiz.question: Me yasa Git ke da muhimmanci lokacin da injiniyoyi da yawa ke aiki tare?
options: Yana taimaka wa kowa ya san canje-canjen da wasu suka yi
Yana toshe injiniyoyi daga aiki tare
quiz.explanation: Git yana sauƙaƙa hadin gwiwa ta hanyar bin diddigin canje-canje daban-daban.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake bin diddigin canje-canje a code

lessons.title: Debugging - Gyara Kuskure a Code
lessons.summary: Yadda ake gano da gyara matsaloli a code
lessons.content:
Debugging shine tsarin gano da gyara kurakurai (bugs) a cikin code. Ba kowace kuskure ke sa code ta daina aiki gaba ɗaya ba (ana kiran hakan 'crash'); wasu kurakurai suna sa code ta bada sakamako mara daidai ba tare da wata sanarwa ba, wanda ke sa su fi wahalar gani.

Kayan aikin da ake amfani da su wajen debugging sun hada da 'print statements' (buga bayani a lokacin gudanar da code domin duba yadda take tafiya) da 'debuggers' (kayan aiki na musamman da ke bada damar tsayar da code a wani mataki domin duba dukkan bayanan da ke ciki a wancan lokacin).

quiz.question: Menene Debugging?
options: Tsarin gano da gyara kurakurai a code
quiz.explanation: Debugging shine aikin gano da gyara matsaloli a cikin code.

quiz.question: Shin dukkan kurakurai suna sa code ta daina aiki gaba ɗaya?
options: A'a, wasu suna sa sakamako mara daidai ba tare da sanarwa ba
E, koyaushe kuskure yana sa code ya tsaya
Kuskure ba ya faruwa a code
quiz.explanation: Wasu kurakurai suna kawo sakamako mara daidai maimakon dakatar da code gaba ɗaya.

quiz.question: Menene 'print statement' wajen debugging?
options: Buga bayani a lokacin gudanar da code domin duba yadda take tafiya
quiz.explanation: Print statements suna bada damar ganin abin da ke faruwa a lokacin code din yana gudana.

quiz.question: Menene 'debugger' a matsayin kayan aiki?
options: Kayan aiki wanda ke tsayar da code a wani mataki domin duba bayanai
quiz.explanation: Debugger yana bada damar dakatar da code a wani mataki domin duba dukkan bayanan da ke ciki.

quiz.question: Me yasa wasu kurakurai ke wahala ga gani?
options: Domin ba sa sa code ya tsaya ko a bada sanarwa
Domin ba a sanya su a code ba
quiz.explanation: Kurakuran da ba sa dakatar da code ko bayar da sanarwa suna wahalar gani.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake gano da gyara matsaloli a code

lessons.title: APIs a Programming
lessons.summary: Yadda ayyukan software daban-daban ke hulda da juna
lessons.content:
A programming, API (Application Programming Interface) tana bada damar wani code ya yi amfani da ayyukan wata software dabam ba tare da sanin yadda ta ginu a ciki ba - kawai sai an san yadda ake tambayarta da irin amsar da za ta bayar. Misali, mai gina app zai iya amfani da API na yanayi (weather API) domin nuna zafin jiki na yau ba tare da kirkirar wata na'ura ta duba yanayi da kansa ba.

API galibi tana amfani da tsarin da ake kira 'REST', inda ake aika bukata (request) ta hanyar intanet, sannan a karba amsa (response) galibi a tsarin JSON, wanda ke da sauki karantawa ga mutum da kwamfuta.

quiz.question: Menene API a programming?
options: Hanyar da ke bada damar code ya yi amfani da ayyukan wata software dabam
quiz.explanation: API tana bada damar sadarwa tsakanin ayyukan software daban-daban.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na amfani da API?
options: Amfani da weather API domin nuna zafin jiki
quiz.explanation: Weather API misali ne na bada bayanin yanayi ba tare da app din ya gina wannan fasaha da kansa ba.

quiz.question: Menene REST a mahallin APIs?
options: Tsarin da ake amfani da shi wajen aika bukata da karban amsa ta intanet
quiz.explanation: REST tsari ne sananne na gina APIs wanda ke amfani da HTTP requests.

quiz.question: Wanne tsari ake amfani da shi galibi wajen amsar API?
quiz.explanation: JSON tsari ne mai sauki karantawa da ake amfani da shi wajen musayar bayanai ta API.

quiz.question: Me ake bukata domin amfani da API?
options: San yadda ake tambayarta da irin amsar da za ta bayar
San yadda aka gina ta a ciki
San duk code din da ke bayanta
quiz.explanation: Ba a bukatar sanin ciki-cikin API, sai kawai yadda ake tambaya da karban amsa.

diagram.caption: Yadda ayyukan software daban-daban ke hulda da juna

lessons.title: Algorithms a Sauki
lessons.summary: Fahimtar tsarin warware matsala a programming
lessons.content:
Algorithm shine jerin matakan da aka tsara don warware wata matsala ta musamman - kamar girke-girke ne na dafa abinci, amma don kwamfuta. Misali, algorithm na tantance mafi girman lamba a cikin jerin lambobi zai bincika kowace lamba ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ya rike wadda ta fi girma.

Akwai algorithms daban-daban da za a iya amfani da su don warware matsala guda ɗaya, wasu suna da sauri fiye da wasu. Ana auna saurin algorithm ta hanyar 'complexity' - misali, algorithm da take bincika kowace lamba a jerin dubu, ta fi hankali fiye da wadda za ta iya nemo amsa a takaice ba tare da duba kowace lamba ba.

quiz.question: Menene Algorithm?
options: Jerin matakan da aka tsara don warware wata matsala
quiz.explanation: Algorithm shine tsarin matakai da ake bi domin warware matsala.

quiz.question: Da me ake kwatanta Algorithm?
options: Girke-girke na dafa abinci, amma don kwamfuta
quiz.explanation: Kamar girke-girke, algorithm yana bayar da matakan da za a bi domin cimma sakamako.

quiz.question: Menene 'complexity' na algorithm?
options: Auna saurin da algorithm ke warware matsala
quiz.explanation: Complexity yana auna nawa lokaci ko albarkatu algorithm ke bukata domin gama aiki.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na abin da algorithm zai iya yi?
options: Tantance mafi girman lamba a cikin jerin lambobi
quiz.explanation: Neman mafi girman lamba misali ne mai sauki na aikin algorithm.

quiz.question: Shin dukkan algorithms na warware matsala guda ɗaya suna da sauri iri ɗaya?
options: A'a, wasu sun fi sauri fiye da wasu
Babu wani bambanci a saurin su
Ba a auna saurin algorithm ba
quiz.explanation: Algorithms daban-daban na iya bambanta sosai a saurin da suke warware matsala ɗaya.

diagram.caption: Fahimtar tsarin warware matsala a programming

lessons.title: Data Structures Masu Zurfi
lessons.summary: Tsarin bayanai kamar Trees da Graphs
lessons.content:
Tree tsari ne na bayanai wanda ke da wata 'saiwa' (root) sannan ya rarrabu zuwa 'reshe' (nodes) da yawa, kowanne yana da nasa 'ya'ya' (children). Ana amfani da wannan tsari wajen abubuwa kamar tsarin fayiloli a kwamfuta ko tsarin iyali.

Graph kuma tsari ne mafi sassauci, inda 'nodes' ke hade da juna ta hanyar 'edges' ba tare da tsayayyen tsari na saiwa da reshe ba - ana amfani da su wajen wakiltar hanyoyin sadarwa (kamar taswirar hanyoyi) ko kuma alaka a shafukan sada zumunta (wanene ke da abota da wanene).

quiz.question: Menene Tree a matsayin data structure?
options: Tsari mai saiwa da ya rarrabu zuwa reshe da yawa
quiz.explanation: Tree yana da saiwa da reshe iri-iri, kama da tsarin fayiloli.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na amfani da Tree?
quiz.explanation: Tsarin fayiloli (folders da subfolders) misali ne na tree structure.

quiz.question: Menene Graph a matsayin data structure?
options: Tsari inda nodes ke hade da juna ta hanyar edges ba tare da tsayayyen tsari ba
quiz.explanation: Graph yana da sassauci fiye da Tree, ba tare da tsayayyen tsarin saiwa ba.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na amfani da Graph?
options: Taswirar hanyoyi ko alakar abota a shafukan sada zumunta
quiz.explanation: Graphs suna dacewa da wakiltar hanyoyin sadarwa ko alaka masu sarkakiya.

quiz.question: Menene bambanci tsakanin Tree da Graph?
options: Tree yana da tsayayyen tsarin saiwa da reshe, Graph ya fi sassauci
quiz.explanation: Tree yana da tsari mai hirarchical, yayin da Graph ya fi sassauci a alakar nodes.

lessons.title: Design Patterns a Software Engineering
lessons.summary: Tsare-tsare na gama-gari wajen tsara software
lessons.content:
Design Patterns tsare-tsare ne da aka gwada suka yi nasara wajen warware matsalolin gama-gari a tsara software. Misali, 'Singleton pattern' yana tabbatar da cewa ana da abu ɗaya kacal na wani nau'i a dukkan app din (misali, saitunan app), maimakon a sami kwafi da yawa masu saba wa juna.

'Observer pattern' kuma yana bada damar wasu sassan code su 'sa ido' kan wani abu, su sami sanarwa ta atomatik idan wani canji ya faru a wancan abu - misali, sabuntar allon app din nan take idan bayanan da ke ciki suka canza. Design patterns suna taimaka wa injiniyoyi warware matsaloli ta hanyar da aka riga aka tabbatar tana aiki.

quiz.question: Menene Design Patterns?
options: Tsare-tsare da aka gwada suka yi nasara wajen warware matsalolin software
quiz.explanation: Design patterns sune hanyoyin da aka tabbatar suna aiki wajen warware matsaloli.

quiz.question: Menene Singleton pattern?
options: Yana tabbatar da abu ɗaya kacal na wani nau'i a dukkan app din
Yana kirkirar kwafi da yawa na wani abu
quiz.explanation: Singleton yana hana kirkirar kwafi da yawa masu saba wa juna.

quiz.question: Menene Observer pattern?
options: Yana bada damar sassan code su sa ido su sami sanarwa idan wani canji ya faru
quiz.explanation: Observer pattern yana bada damar sanarwa ta atomatik idan wani abu ya canza.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na amfani da Observer pattern?
options: Sabuntar allon app nan take idan bayanai suka canza
quiz.explanation: Sabuntar allo ta atomatik misali ne mai sauki na yadda Observer pattern ke aiki.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce Design Patterns ke bayarwa?
options: Warware matsaloli ta hanyar da aka riga aka tabbatar tana aiki
quiz.explanation: Amfani da patterns da aka gwada yana rage hadarin kuskure a tsarin software.

diagram.caption: Tsare-tsare na gama-gari wajen tsara software

lessons.title: Testing - Unit Tests da Automation
lessons.summary: Yadda ake tabbatar da code yana aiki daidai
lessons.content:
Unit Test wani karamin code ne da aka rubuta domin gwada wani sashi kadan (misali, function guda ɗaya) na babban code din, don tabbatar da yana bayar da sakamako daidai a kowane lokaci. Idan wani injiniya ya canza wani code a nan gaba, wadannan tests za su iya gudana ta atomatik domin tabbatar da canjin bai karya wani abu ba.

Test Automation yana nufin sanya wadannan gwaje-gwaje su gudana ta atomatik, misali kowane lokaci da injiniya ya loda sabon code (ta amfani da CI/CD), maimakon a gwada code din da hannu kowane lokaci, wanda zai dauki lokaci mai yawa kuma ya fi saurin samun kuskure.

quiz.question: Menene Unit Test?
options: Karamin code da aka rubuta domin gwada wani sashi kadan na babban code
quiz.explanation: Unit test yana tabbatar da wani sashi na code yana aiki daidai.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce Unit Tests ke bayarwa idan aka canza code a nan gaba?
options: Za su gano idan canjin ya karya wani abu
quiz.explanation: Unit tests suna gudana ta atomatik domin tabbatar da sabon canji bai karya wani abu ba.

quiz.question: Menene Test Automation?
options: Sanya gwaje-gwajen code su gudana ta atomatik
quiz.explanation: Test automation yana bada damar gwaji ba tare da bukatar hannun mutum kowane lokaci ba.

quiz.question: Me yasa gwaji da hannu koyaushe bai fi kyau ba?
options: Yana dauke lokaci mai yawa kuma ya fi saurin samun kuskure
Ya fi sauri fiye da automation
quiz.explanation: Gwaji da hannu yana da yiwuwar kuskuren mutum da kuma dauke lokaci mai yawa.

quiz.question: A wanne tsari ake amfani da test automation, kamar yadda aka koya a darasin DevOps?
quiz.explanation: CI/CD yana amfani da automated tests kafin sakin sabon code.

lessons.title: Concurrency da Parallel Programming
lessons.summary: Yadda ake gudanar da ayyuka da yawa lokaci ɗaya
lessons.content:
Concurrency yana bada damar wani code ya gudanar da ayyuka da yawa a lokaci guda ta hanyar sauya tsakaninsu cikin sauri, yayin da Parallel Programming ke ainihin gudanar da ayyuka biyu ko sama da haka a lokaci guda ɗaya, ta amfani da kwamfuta mai fiye da 'core' guda ɗaya.

Misali, wani app zai iya loda hoto a bango (background) yayin da mai amfani ke ci gaba da amfani da sauran fasalolin app din - wannan yana amfani da concurrency. Wadannan dabaru suna da muhimmanci wajen sa apps su yi sauri kuma su kasance masu inganci, amma suna kuma da kalubale nasu, kamar 'race conditions' inda sakamako zai iya bambanta bisa yadda ayyukan suka gudana.

quiz.question: Menene Concurrency?
options: Gudanar da ayyuka da yawa ta hanyar sauya tsakaninsu cikin sauri
quiz.explanation: Concurrency yana kwaikwayon aiwatar da ayyuka da yawa lokaci ɗaya ta hanyar sauyawa cikin sauri.

quiz.question: Menene Parallel Programming?
options: Ainihin gudanar da ayyuka biyu ko sama a lokaci guda ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Parallel Programming yana amfani da fiye da core guda ɗaya domin gudanar da ayyuka a lokaci ɗaya na ainihi.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na concurrency a app?
options: Loda hoto a bango yayin da mai amfani ke ci gaba da amfani da app
quiz.explanation: Wannan misali ne na ayyuka da yawa da ke gudana kusan lokaci guda a app.

quiz.question: Menene 'race condition'?
options: Matsala inda sakamako zai iya bambanta bisa yadda ayyukan suka gudana
quiz.explanation: Race condition kalubale ne na concurrency inda tsarin gudanar ayyuka ke shafar sakamako.

quiz.question: Me ake bukata don Parallel Programming na ainihi?
options: Kwamfuta mai fiye da core guda ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Ainihin gudanar ayyuka lokaci ɗaya yana bukatar fiye da core guda ɗaya.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake gudanar da ayyuka da yawa lokaci ɗaya

lessons.title: Tsaro a Rubuta Code (Secure Coding)
lessons.summary: Yadda ake rubuta code mai kariya daga hare-hare
lessons.content:
Secure Coding yana nufin rubuta code ta hanyar da za ta guji barin hanyoyin da masu kutse za su iya amfani da su wajen kai hari. Misali, SQL Injection wata dabara ce da masu kutse ke amfani da ita don shigar da umarni marasa kyau a cikin wani filin shigarwa (input field) na app, don su iya samun damar shiga database ba bisa ƙa'ida ba.

Don guje wa wannan, injiniyoyi na amfani da dabarar 'input validation' (bincika duk wani abu da mai amfani ya shigar kafin a yi amfani da shi) da 'parameterized queries' (tsari na musamman na aika umarni zuwa database wanda ke hana masu kutse shigar da nasu umarni a ciki).

quiz.question: Menene Secure Coding?
options: Rubuta code ta hanyar da za ta guji barin hanyoyin hari
quiz.explanation: Secure coding yana rage yiwuwar masu kutse su sami hanyar kai hari ta code din.

quiz.question: Menene SQL Injection?
options: Dabarar shigar da umarni marasa kyau a filin shigarwa domin samun damar database ba bisa ƙa'ida ba
quiz.explanation: SQL Injection wata hanya ce da masu kutse ke amfani da ita wajen kai hari ta filin shigarwa.

quiz.question: Menene 'input validation'?
options: Bincika duk wani abu da mai amfani ya shigar kafin a yi amfani da shi
quiz.explanation: Input validation yana tabbatar da cewa bayanan da aka shigar ba su da hatsari kafin a sarrafa su.

quiz.question: Menene 'parameterized queries' ke yi?
options: Suna hana masu kutse shigar da nasu umarni a cikin bukatar database
Suna kara wa masu kutse damar shiga
quiz.explanation: Parameterized queries suna kare database daga umarni na masu kutse.

quiz.question: Me yasa secure coding ke da muhimmanci?
options: Domin yana kare app da bayanan mai amfani daga hare-hare
Domin dole ne bisa doka kadai
quiz.explanation: Rashin secure coding na iya barin app da bayanan mai amfani cikin hadari.

lessons.title: Sana'o'i a Fannin Software Engineering
lessons.summary: Hanyoyin fara sana'a a fannin shirye-shirye
lessons.content:
Akwai sana'o'i da yawa a fannin software: 'Frontend Developer' yana gina bangaren da mai amfani ke gani da hulda dashi kai tsaye, 'Backend Developer' yana gina tsarin da ke bayan fage (kamar databases da servers), kuma 'Full-Stack Developer' yana iya yin duka biyu.

Don fara wannan tafarki, ana ba da shawarar zaɓan yare guda ɗaya (kamar Python ko JavaScript) a koya sosai, sannan a gina ayyuka masu sauki (projects) domin nuna iyawarka, tunda gina abubuwa na ainihi yana koya wa mutum abubuwa da yawa fiye da karatun ka'idoji kawai.

quiz.question: Menene aikin Frontend Developer?
options: Gina bangaren da mai amfani ke gani da hulda dashi kai tsaye
quiz.explanation: Frontend Developer yana mai da hankali kan bangaren da mai amfani ke gani.

quiz.question: Menene aikin Backend Developer?
options: Gina tsarin da ke bayan fage kamar databases da servers
quiz.explanation: Backend Developer yana kula da tsarin da ke bayan fage na app.

quiz.question: Menene Full-Stack Developer?
options: Wanda ke iya yin duka Frontend da Backend
quiz.explanation: Full-Stack Developer yana iya aiki a bangarorin biyu.

quiz.question: Me ake ba da shawara a matsayin mataki na farko don shiga fannin software?
options: Zaɓan yare guda ɗaya a koya sosai
Koyon dukkan yaruka a lokaci ɗaya
Jira har a gama koyon komai
quiz.explanation: Zaɓan yare ɗaya yana bada tushe mai ƙarfi kafin fadada zuwa wasu.

quiz.question: Me yasa gina ayyuka na ainihi (projects) ke da amfani?
options: Yana koya wa mutum abubuwa da yawa fiye da karatun ka'idoji kadai
quiz.explanation: Gina abubuwa na ainihi yana bunkasa gogewa mai amfani sosai.
